name: chengdu-reader
description: Firefox 沉浸式阅读扩展：自动清理正文空白行与多余间距

scripts.lint: npx --yes web-ext lint  --source-dir . --ignore-files tests tools dist package.json package-lock.json node_modules README.md .gitignore .web-ext-profile .tts-key .tts-key-probe
scripts.start: npx --yes web-ext run --source-dir . --firefox-profile .web-ext-profile --keep-profile-changes --ignore-files tests tools dist package.json package-lock.json node_modules README.md .gitignore .web-ext-profile .tts-key .tts-key-probe
scripts.build: npx --yes web-ext build --source-dir . --ignore-files tests tools dist package.json package-lock.json node_modules README.md .gitignore .web-ext-profile .tts-key .tts-key-probe --filename chengdu-reader-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest --artifacts-dir dist
